problem.title: Construct a Two-Dimensional Prefix Sum Matrix
problem.problemStatement: Given an N × M matrix of integers, construct its two-dimensional prefix sum matrix, where each cell contains the sum of all elements in the rectangle from (0,0) to the current cell.
problem.input: • First line contains N and M. • Next N lines each contain M integers.
problem.output: • Print the two-dimensional prefix sum matrix.
